text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mechanisation is intensively introduced in the Tunisian agricultural sector, but human labor force still needed in market gardening.
- A study is going on in Tunisia for the Inter-Maghreb highway.
- The government is preparing legislation on credit expected to be approved in the second half of the year.
- Tunisia abolished slavery 150 years ago. High Education Minister Daly Jazi on Friday chaired the celebrations.
